facts.fact: DatacenterDynamics reported on 7 July 2017 that a new Tier III data center built by SenConnect for Tigo, both Millicom subsidiaries, had opened in Diamniadio, with Uptime's EMEA head calling it suited to storing enterprise data.
The SenConnect/Tigo Diamniadio data center opened in July 2017 was Tier 3 Design certified by the Uptime Institute (design certification, not constructed facility).

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
